overview_description.description:
How many times have you forgotten something back home and you only realize this when you have reached your destination?
British delivery platform Peyk now available in Qatar.
Our exclusive collaboration with Peyk has given us the opportunity to bring over a British Delivery Platform to our home country Qatar.

At PASS "powered by Peyk", we offer a 24/7 instant delivery service allowing anyone to send or receive (almost) anything from A to B within a matter of minutes!

Pass has been acquired by a local Qatari entrepreneur in July 2023.

product.name: Instant Delivery Platform
product.description: A 24/7 parcel delivery service in Qatar offering same day, express, and last mile logistics for businesses and individuals.

product.name: Business Deliveries
product.description: Delivery services tailored for businesses including on-demand, scheduled, and bulk shipments with real-time tracking and scalable logistics.

product.name: E-Commerce Fulfillment
product.description: Comprehensive fulfillment services for online stores including warehousing, inventory management, order picking, packing, and last-mile delivery.

product.name: PassAPI Integration
product.description: An API solution enabling businesses to integrate Pass Delivery’s services into their own platforms for order placement, pricing, and real-time tracking.

product.name: Mobile App and Web Dashboard
product.description: User interfaces for booking, managing, and tracking deliveries via smartphone or web, supporting multiple transport options and real-time updates.
